413-539-3821-4679-6023.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
413-539-3821-4679-6023.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-3249-4871--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-4871--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

4215-4247-6730.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, moving any counters from it onto another creature you control, and then shuffling Sin into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Sin and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
4215-4247-6730.notes: In order to get infinite +1/+1 counters, remove as many counters as possible when Sin enters, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin as it enters. Those counters can then be moved to another creature when Sin dies.

413-2728-5662-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
413-2728-5662-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
413-2728-5662-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage.
Repeat from step 4.

6797-7084-7892.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

338-475-1379-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-475-1379-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-1379-3197-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1379-3197-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

206-2034-5477-5660-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-5189-7061-7426.easyPrerequisites: There are two removable +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
2034-5189-7061-7426.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling, putting two +1/+1 counters on Berta due to Solid Ground.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1115-4613-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
1115-4613-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1115-4613-5310-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

2281-3967-6909.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2281-3967-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. 
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Carnage.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Carnage.
When Carnage dies, Saffi triggers, returning Carnage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1912-4131-7170.description:
Cause Basalt Monolith to become a creature using Living Brain.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

233-343-2645-6871.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding {B} as it's a Swamp land due to Toph and Urborg
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {B}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2366-3499-3688-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3499-3688-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-2478-7060.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

944-6867-7042.description:
Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Loyal Sky Bison.
Cast Appa, Loyal Sky Bison from exile by paying {0}.
Appa, Steadfast Guardian triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Appa, Loyal Sky Bison enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Steadfast Guardian.
Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

1818-5010-5231-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-5010-5231-6900.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

132-2816-3980.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Sisay's Ring's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Umbral Mantle by paying {U}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

500-1777-5913.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Pinnacle Monk and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing a token, adding {B}{B} plus an additional amount of {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2. 
Repeat.

2438-5058-6351.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1497-3327-4613-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1497-3327-4613-6602.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Tromell.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

856-4321-5231-6462.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5231-6462.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Kheru Goldkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

277-2034-2653-5552.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten permanents.
277-2034-2653-5552.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation.
When Temple of Cultivation enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Temple of Cultivation.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

1170-1328-1849-4251.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any Samurai you control.
1170-1328-1849-4251.description:
Declare Godo and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control, and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Godo.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

647-864-1312-2034-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

1233-3259-4412.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness if it isn't a Goblin.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-3259-4412.description:
Declare Squee and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a 1/1 Goblin creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Goblin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1722-2034-3583-4268.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-4268.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1127-2440-4758.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Spirits.
1127-2440-4758.description:
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
When Blinking Spirit enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {W}.
Repeat.
If you control six or more Spirits, this combo nets infinite mana.

49-586-1799-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {R}.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Priest of Gix on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Priest of Gix into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

602-1832-2034-2756.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You do not control an Army.
602-1832-2034-2756.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and one life, causing you to loot.
Lazotep Chancellor and Feast of Sanity trigger.
Resolve the Lazotep Chancellor trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 0/0 Zombie Army creature token, then put two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain one life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie Army, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

326-4558.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard.
326-4558.description:
Cast Chain of Smog by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Extus triggers, returning any nonlegendary creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Chain of Smog, discarding a nonlegendary creature card and one other card, and causing you to copy Chain Smog, targeting yourself.
Repeat from step 2.

970-1656-1742.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Asmodeus' first ability by paying {B}{B}{B}, causing you to draw seven cards.
If Skirge Familiar is in your graveyard, activate Necrotic Ooze using Skirge Familiar's ability by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Otherwise, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat step 2 or 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-2557-2775.description:
Activate Slimefoot by paying {4}, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Saproling tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Slimefoot triggers twice, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

518-1984-5109.description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}, making it impossible for you to lose the game or have your life total reduced below 1 this turn.
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, triggering itself, targeting any creature.
In response, cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting the same creature and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Resolve Volcano Hellion's trigger, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to the targeted creature and to you, reducing your life total to 1 due to Angel's Grace.
Arcbond's delayed triggered ability triggers, dealing an equal amount of damage to all other creatures and all players, which does not change your life total due to Angel's Grace.

618-4394.description:
Activate the mutated Everquill Phoenix and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.

65-717-1094-2628-5181.description:
Cycle Slippery Karst for {0} due to Fluctuator.
Escape Protocol and Bone Miser trigger.
Stack the triggers such that Bone Miser's ability resolves first, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability using {1} to pay for it to blink Golgari Findbroker.
When Golgari Findbroker ETBs, return Slippery Karst to your hand.
Resolve the cycling trigger and draw a card.
